CUSTOMER POLICY

Refunds & cancellations

Last updated: 1 October 2026

This policy covers project-based digital services purchased from Surecomply Services.

How to request a cancellation or refund

Email aj@tndn.in with your project reference, payment details sufficient to identify the payment, and the reason for your request. Do not send full card numbers or account passwords.

Before work starts

If you cancel before work begins, the service fee paid is eligible for a full refund. Any separately authorised third-party purchase is handled according to the terms disclosed before that purchase.

After work starts

If you cancel after work has begun, we will identify the work completed and costs already incurred under the agreed scope. The unused portion of your service fee is eligible for a refund. We will provide the calculation and explain any deductions.

Incomplete or incorrect deliverables

If a deliverable does not match the agreed scope, contact us with details. We will review the issue and offer correction within an agreed timeframe. If we cannot provide the agreed service, the undelivered portion is eligible for a refund.

Refund processing

We will communicate the outcome of your request by email. Approved refunds are initiated within 7 business days to the original payment method where available. The time for the credit to appear depends on the payment provider and your bank.

Third-party costs

Domain names, hosting, paid assets, and software licences are purchased only with your prior agreement. Their cancellation and refund eligibility depend on the relevant provider’s terms disclosed at the time of purchase.

Your rights

This policy does not limit any refund or consumer rights available under applicable law.
